message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.given: A cold sweetness settles under your tongue. The world is a little redder than it was.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.cured: The warmth of other people stops calling to you, and your mouth is only a mouth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.sated: For a while, nothing in you asks for anything.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.stage.1: Your hands feel slow, and every pulse in the room is loud.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.stage.2: Your strength is thin as paper. You catch yourself staring at throats.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.stage.3: The dark leans in. You would give anything for a warm cup.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.sun: The light on your skin is a hand pressing down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.holy: This ground does not want you on it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.bitten: Something cold at your neck, and then a long, soft weakness.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.passed: You give back a little of what you took, and it is not only blood.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.stare: Your eyes fix. Whoever you look at long enough will come.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.riposte: The blow finds a cloak and a cloud of wings.
message.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.spent: The swelling goes out of you all at once.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.menu.speaker: The thirst
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.menu.colony: A colony, for the one in front of you
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.rite.nothing: I have nothing for you that you do not already have.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.rite.unready: You have not bled enough for it yet. Or you have not brought what it takes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.rite.step1.w: There is a last thing in the red art, and it is not taught. It is given, once. If it is not washed out in the first few nights, it does not wash out. Do you still wish to hear the price?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.rite.step2.w: %1$s wings of the things that fly by night, and %2$s in coin. You will not eat like the rest of them after. The day will not love you. Are you sure?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.drinker.rite.done: It is done. Drink slowly, and keep out of the light.
